name: zodiacs-developer
description: Build and verify astrology integrations with the published Zodiacs engine, bounded sky tools and local chart comparison.

interface.longDescription: Build Moon widgets, sky calendars and astrology APIs with the published Zodiacs engine. Verify calculation records and test timezones with synthetic inputs. The local developer server supports natal calculations without a listener or outbound connection; the assistant provider can still receive inputs and results. Personal hosted charts and public directory availability are not offered by this review candidate.
